model_sql:
SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(inv.qty_on_hand) AS total_qty,
    CASE WHEN SUM(inv.qty_on_hand) < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS low_stock
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} AS p
LEFT JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'inventory') }} AS inv
    ON inv.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name

explanation: This procedure builds a low-stock report with one row per product, showing the product's total quantity on hand across all warehouses. It flags a product with 1 if its total is below 20 and 0 otherwise. Products with no inventory rows still appear, with a null total and a flag of 0.
